articles.summary: Dr Anne Tan Kendrick diagnosed herself with Stage 3 ovarian cancer after spotting tumors When Dr Anne Tan Kendrick spotted tumours during an ultrasound she performed on herself, she knew it was cancer. articles.summary: UN aid teams warned Somalia faces a real risk of famine. At least six million people in Somalia are going days without enough food, UN aid teams warned on Friday, highlighting that nearly two million of this number are young children “at high risk of illness or death”.
